name: Unicchi! ~Weenie Witches~
source:
Fokrim Magic Academy studies magic for over 100 years. One spring day President Rivade-Fokrim dies, and lots of teachers and students leave academy afterwards. Only director's widow and three poor female students stay. Protagonist becomes teacher for these girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
福克里姆魔法学院研究魔法已有百余年。某个春日，院长里瓦德·福克里姆去世，大批教师和学生随后离开学院。最终只剩院长遗孀与三名贫困女学生，主角则成为这些女孩的老师。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
